versions.content: Communication Management shall provide an interface to stop offering services Description: Application developers shall be able to stop the offering services which the application started to offer before. Rationale: After the offering of a service, it shall be possible to stop the offering of the service later on. Dependencies: – Use Case: Application “A” stops offering the wall clock service. Supporting Material: –
